attests.rateSchedule: Flat 3.07% (72 P.S. § 7302) — in effect continuously since 2004, NO scheduled statutory step-down, NO revenue trigger, NO bracket table; held forward. The 2.8% Shapiro budget proposal was never enacted — excluded.
attests.standardDeduction: NONE — $0 both MFJ and single ('No provision'). PA has no standard deduction and no personal exemption; taxable investment income is taxed from the first dollar.
attests.exemptions: Eight-class system (72 P.S. § 7303), NOT federal-AGI-derived. Social Security 100% exempt. Retirement-plan withdrawals AND Roth conversions EXEMPT at qualified age (>= 59.5), TAXED below it (the conservative arm). Taxable-account interest/dividends/net gains taxed at 3.07% (no LTCG preference, no holding-period distinction). OUT (named, never modeled, conservative-direction): US/PA-obligation interest exemption, Tax Forgiveness (Schedule SP), local Earned Income Tax ($0 on decumulation income), Philadelphia School Income Tax.
